messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error rate detected for /v1/generate (5xx spike) across us-east and eu-west. Threshold breached: 5xx > 4% for 3m. Pager duty triggered.

sarah: I’m on it. paging who’s on-call for infra/runtime?

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-48321 — paged sarah (primary) and tony (secondary).

sarah: quick triage notes — edge logs show a lot of 429 responses from ratelimit-service followed by gateway timeouts 502/504. Looks like clients are being throttled and some clients are retrying aggressively, causing backend saturation.

maria: pasting snippets from edge logs and gateway: 
```
[edge] 2024-05-31T10:02:12Z client=acme svc=ratelimit status=429 quota_id=global_quota
[gateway] 2024-05-31T10:02:14Z request_id=req_9ab3 timeout after 15s upstream=timeout
[runtime] 2024-05-31T10:02:15Z cpu=95% errors=120 5xx
```

sarah: looking at config-store -> /configs/ratelimit/global.json. Last deploy (2024-05-31 09:45) introduced a new global_enforcement flag and lowered default quota unexpectedly.

sarah: fetch config: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://config-store.internal/configs/ratelimit/global.json | jq .
{
  "global_enforcement": true,
  "global_quota_per_minute": 1000,
  "per_customer_quota": null
}
```

ton y: that global_quota looks way too low for traffic. expected ~10000. we should bump immediately to stop 429 cascade. i can apply a hotfix via admin API.

tony: applying temp change — running admin API patch: 
```
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://admin.internal/ratelimit/config -d '{"global_quota_per_minute":10000}'
```

sarah: applying now.

sarah: response from admin API: {"status":"ok","applied":true,"config_version":"v2024-05-31T10:06:22Z"}

maria: seeing immediate drop in 429s at edge. 5xx rate falling from 6.3% -> 1.2% in 3m. Nice.

sarah: but note: backend still seeing retry spikes — some gateways saturated by retries. we need to throttle retries at the client-facing gateway and enable circuit-breaker on upstream.

devops-bot: Suggested actions: 1) disable global_enforcement toggle to give per-customer quotas time to kick in, 2) enable gateway retry-smoothing (backoff), 3) scale up autoscaler for runtime pool by +2 nodes.

sarah: disabling global_enforcement via admin toggle now: 
```
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"global_enforcement":false}' https://admin.internal/ratelimit/config
```

sarah: toggle applied.

maria: gateway config updated to exponential backoff for retries; pushing a 2-node scale up to runtime pool (temporary).

sarah: 5xx rates normalized to baseline (~0.6%) after these mitigations. CPU on runtime fell back to normal. Monitoring graphs: https://obs.internal/dashboards/incident/PD-48321 (link)

sarah: quick customer impact summary for PD notes: 
- window: 2024-05-31T09:58 to 2024-05-31T10:12 UTC
- affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat (mostly large batch customers)
- symptoms: 429 rate increased then caused upstream timeouts/502/504 for some requests, leading to transient failures for ~7% of requests from impacted customers during window
- mitigation: bumped global quota, disabled global enforcement, enabled retry backoff, scaled runtime pool

tony: moving to handoff — I’ll take night oncall for followups. sarah, please add immediate follow-ups as tickets:
  - BACKPORT: add validation to ratelimit deploys that prevent global_quota < 5000 without an explicit override (SEV guard)
  - OBS: alert when ratelimit config changes (diff alerts)
  - RUNTIME: add circuit breaker and retry budget to gateway

sarah: creating tickets now and linking to PD-48321. Also will open a PR to revert the problematic deploy that introduced global_enforcement default.

sarah: adding postmortem stub: root cause = misconfigured ratelimit deployment (global enforcement + low default quota) + lack of config-change alerting. Contributing factor = client retry behavior without retry budgets.

tony: ack. I’ll monitor overnight and notify any top-tier customers we saw errors for (we have a short impact note ready). If anything flares, page me.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-48321 severity downgraded to SEV-2; acknowledged by sarah and tony.

sarah: closing incident channel here but keeping PD open until followups are tracked. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Handoff note: sarah -> tony, summary: ratelimit misconfig caused cascade 429->5xx, mitigations applied, follow-ups created.

ton y: got it. good catch everyone.
